build_cuda_extension_mmdet_iou3d: build the mmdet_iou3d CUDA extension module from iou3d_kernel.cu and sort_vert_kernel.cu source files
build_pytorch_cuda_extension: build a PyTorch CUDA extension using CUDAExtension and BuildExtension from torch.utils.cpp_extension
compile_iou3d_kernel: compile the iou3d CUDA kernel and C++ bindings into a Python-importable extension module
compile_sort_vert_kernel: compile the sort_vert CUDA kernel and C++ bindings into a Python-importable extension module
setup_cuda_extension_headers: set up header files iou3d.h, sort_vert.h, cuda_utils.h, and utils.h for the CUDA extension build
